neighbours.label: description of a state that held in a past era ('in earlier centuries / a century ago / at that time the place was unsuitable …'): how things used to be
fire: A hundred years ago the plateau was uninhabitable for most of the winter.
In earlier centuries the coast was unsafe for ships because of the reefs.
In those days the pass was closed to wagons from October to May.
At that time the voyage from Lisbon to Goa was about six months.
Three centuries ago the delta was unfit for grazing because of the salt.
In the Roman period the lake was far larger than the present one.
In earlier times the hills were bare of trees, though woods cover them today.
Fifty years ago the estuary was too polluted for salmon.
quiet: Today the plateau is habitable for most of the winter.
The coast is safe for ships because of the new lighthouses.
Last week the council closed the pass to wagons for repairs.
The voyage from Lisbon to Goa takes about three weeks.
The delta is ideal for grazing because of the rich grass.
In 1962 the engineers drained part of the lake.
The hills are covered with trees and crossed by many streams.
Last spring the fishermen caught a record number of salmon.

notes: The top examples share no token. Probes: 'A century ago the valley was unsuitable …' 0.63, 'Two hundred years ago the marsh was impassable' 0.50, 'In earlier times the island was covered' 0.34, 'At that time the journey … was about' 0.32, 'In those days the river was too shallow' 0.28, 'In the Middle Ages the harbour was much deeper' 0.21; 'Before the war the town had' 0.08, 'Back then a letter took' 0.05, dated past events 0.02-0.03, present-tense states 0.01. The output direction promotes ' original', ' unchanged', ' altered', ' modified'.
